description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Ire Shaman, adding {R}.
When Ire Shaman dies, Yedora triggers, returning Ire Shaman from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Ire Shaman by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Ire Shaman's morph ability by paying {R}, turning it face up.
Ire Shaman triggers, exiling the top card of your library with the ability to play it this turn.
Repeat.
